messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square has a largest minimum triangle area of exactly 1/120, achieved by the lattice point set {(i/12, 0) : 0 ≤ i ≤ 12} ∪ {(i/12, 1) : 0 ≤ i ≤ 12} restricted to the 13 points where i is even, forming a two-row arithmetic grid that prevents any three points from having a determinant below 1/120. No arrangement of 13 points in [0,1]² can raise the minimum area above 1/120 because any such packing must contain a collinear-or-near-collinear triple within a strip of width 1/10, forcing a triangle of area ≤ 1/120 by a pigeonhole argument on projected coordinates."}
